summary: Every requirement is met. (1) The bump is in place: plugins/shipwright-plan/uv.lock lines 486-491 now pin pyasn1 0.6.5. That is the fixed release for CVE-2026-119194..119197 (alerts #1454-1457). The sdist and wheel URLs, sha256 hashes, sizes and upload times (2026-10-27) are consistent with a 0.6.5 lock entry. (2) The dependent pyasn1-modules 0.4.2 block (line ~499) still lists { name = "pyasn1" } with no version pin, so the version change does not ripple into it. (3) I re-checked the other lock files: a Grep for name = "pyasn1" over **/uv.lock in this worktree found only plugins/shipwright-plan/uv.lock, so no other lock file needs the bump. (4) No pyproject.toml mentions pyasn1, so no project constraint conflicts with 0.6.5. (5) Scope: the diff touches only the pyasn1 package block, and the grep context matches that. I had no shell tool, so I could not run git diff to independently confirm that no other package block changed. Nothing in the change goes beyond the request.
